MAP: Did your state try to stop changing the clocks this year? 
 KRQE NEWS 13 – Breaking News, Albuquerque News, New Mexico News, Weather, and Videos 
 MAP: Did your state try to stop changing the clocks this year?
 Addy Bink and The Hill 
 4 hours ago 
 (NEXSTAR) – We’re just weeks away from changing our clocks as daylight saving time comes to an end. If lawmakers in several states had their way this year, their clocks may not be changing. 
 Daylight saving time ends as early as possible this year , with clocks “falling back” an hour in the early morning hours of Nov. 1.
 The House passed a bill to make daylight saving time permanent, but it has stalled out in the Senate . The chamber is adjourned until mid-November, and there are doubts that the legislation has the support needed to pass .

 The legislation, known as the Sunshine Protection Act, is the critical piece of legislation for the 19 states that have already approved permanent daylight saving time within their jurisdiction. States can opt for permanent standard time, as two already have , but year-round daylight saving time requires Congressional action. 
 Several states tried to make standard time their year-round time this year, but efforts mostly failed, fizzled or were flattened by the end of the legislative session.
 In Virginia, the state Senate passed a bill that would make standard time permanent, so long as the District of Columbia and Maryland do the same. While neither has taken action on that, Virginia’s bill will carry over to its 2027 legislative session.
 Standard time-related legislation in Pennsylvania , New Jersey and Michigan is still active, as their lawmakers are still in session.
 Meanwhile, tracking by Nexstar shows more than 100 pieces of state legislation were introduced during this year’s legislative session. 
 The interactive map shows where that legislation was introduced. 
 Only a few remain active, including legislation in New Jersey and Pennsylvania . Separate bills in Pennsylvania and Ohio would urge Congress to make daylight saving time permanent in the U.S.
 Health experts generally agree that we should  lock our clocks on permanent standard time , despite federal efforts largely focusing on making daylight saving time permanent .
 Not everyone supports the shift to permanent daylight saving time, either. It could impact how thousands practice their religion . It could have “considerable implications” on your future flights , at least temporarily.
 It’s difficult to say when, if ever, the Senate will pick up the Sunshine Protection Act. Efforts by the Senate to fast-track its version were thwarted .
 Congress is also considering two bills in the House that would give states the option to observe year-round daylight saving time, a bill to make half-daylight saving time permanent , and a newly introduced bill to make standard time permanent , with exceptions.
